acceptance: Three fresh sequential Philip candidates. Every original particularity must be explicit, all mandatory fields present, lives coherent and meaningfully varied. No unsupported future named-event date/location claims, no factual premise errors, and no prescribed opinions or tastes.

failure_preserved.error: Planned a total solar eclipse in northern Spain in 2027.
failure_preserved.verification: NASA lists the August 2, 2027 total solar eclipse in southern Spain, North Africa, Saudi Arabia and Yemen.

limitations: Adaptive confirmation is not independent fixed-input replication or representative population sampling. A separate recipe remains selected for Grace; do not claim the new rule was tested on her case.
